Corollary
[finite extinction topological classification] Source: cao-zhu 1. Corollary 7.4.4\group Canonical-Neighborhood Induction

Let $M$ be a compact orientable three-manifold with nonnegative scalar curvature. Then either $M$ is flat or it is diffeomorphic to a connected sum of a finite copies of $\mathbb {S}^2\times \mathbb {S}^1$ and $\mathbb {S}^3/\Gamma $ $($the metric quotients of the round three-sphere$).$
